name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 56 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-01-13, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
